parsed.degree_signal: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
parsed.notes:
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS sets required labels; PREFERRED / BONUS sets nice-to-have labels. Technologies appearing only in the role summary or responsibilities are excluded.
ML infrastructure maps to AI Infrastructure; LLM serving frameworks maps to Model serving without adding a separate LLMs parent criterion. DeepSpeed-Inference maps to DeepSpeed.
Docker/Kubernetes is read as alternative examples of containerized deployments.
Other alternative asks contain fewer than two mapped skills, so no singleton alternative groups are emitted.
Debugging is kept unmapped rather than equated with software testing. Hardware-specific techniques and open-source contribution practice without fitting taxonomy entries are retained in unmapped.
The 3+ years threshold supports mid seniority; the title itself states no seniority. The highest degree explicitly named is PhD, and a related field is not an experience-based degree substitute.
